tests.name: annual payment, monthly release, original consideration and whole-contract refunds
real default clock retains exact milliseconds through verified payment and lot issuance
one annual payment creates twelve rights, only first month is issued, payment replay cannot mint the year
cancelled renewal retains twelve monthly installments; retries, catch-up and calendar anchors preserve total cash
seven-day unused annual whole-order refund removes only issued credits, blocks future grants and never refunds twice
failed cash refund unfreezes its issued batch and allows overdue paid installments
legacy monthly request hash survives omitted or explicit monthly; annual cannot reuse that request
year mandate binds annual amount/interval, can be reopened after cancellation, and charges once only at anniversary
actual review settlement uses annual lot consideration and disqualifies whole-contract cash withdrawal

addedAssertions: assert.equal((await pool.query('SELECT count(*)::int n FROM bb_recharge_orders WHERE owner_user_id=$1 AND request_id=$2',[who,annual.request_id])).rows[0].n,0,'a rejected annual key never creates an order')
assert.equal(await orderCount(),ordersBefore,'rejection does not create another checkout')
assert.deepEqual(await rejection(),originalRejection,'active mandate retry retains the same durable rejection')
assert.deepEqual(await rejection(),originalRejection,'verified cancellation never revives a rejected key')
assert.equal((await pool.query('SELECT request_id FROM bb_recharge_orders WHERE owner_user_id=$1 AND id=$2',[who,changed.order.order_id])).rows[0].request_id,fresh.request_id)
assert.equal(await orderCount(),ordersBefore+1,'only the new explicit annual request creates one order')
assert.equal((await pool.query('SELECT count(*)::int n FROM bb_recharge_orders WHERE owner_user_id=$1 AND request_id=$2',[who,annual.request_id])).rows[0].n,0)
assert.deepEqual(await rejection(),originalRejection,'new purchase leaves the rejected annual key unchanged')

boundaryTests.name: synthetic subscriptions share the wallet, retain original cash rights, refund atomically and renew once
verified payment grants once, 90-day rights and cash ratio survive cancellation
a stale tab subscription request is durably rejected without an order and topup stays available
legacy HTTP replays only the exact owner rejection and can never create a new subscription payment
expired manual renewals with pending, active or cancel-pending mandates durably reject without blocking topups
checkout failure before channel creation stays unknown until authenticated expiry, then permits a new purchase
only a wholly unused period refunds 199 cash by removing 21000 points, unknown status stays held
task and cash-refund holds are separate in the same wallet and each period
consumption prevents subscription cash refund; expired correction preserves original paid ratio
the application rejects an unused subscription after the seven-day refund window
topup is 1:1 permanent and does not inherit a subscription discount
native checkout has no recurring capability; an authenticated synthetic mandate renews once after timeout
a delayed refund for an earlier period cannot cancel a later paid period or its mandate
